items.t: Paved and roofed area went from 0.4% in 1985 to 0.7% in 2025 across 354 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work (area-weighted).

9 of 354 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have water the state lists as impaired for aquatic life, 16 for salt or chloride; 29 have a discharge permit holder in significant noncompliance.
0 of 354 small watersheds in the river basins where IWLA volunteers work have a volunteer bug site surveyed since 2021; 2 of 2 high-need ones have none.
